opening.argument: The video proceeds as a step-by-step walkthrough of BNB arbitrage and an AI trading-bot platform, beginning with configuration of the trading pair. The wallet-address field and deposit screen show what the interface asks a user to do; the displayed net-profit figure shows what the screen reports. None of those observations alone establishes deception, a completed transaction, or a genuine return. The stalled withdrawal concerned a different, unidentified platform, so it does not establish an outcome for the platform shown here. The stated testing context and explicit warning that crypto trading carries risk and profits are not guaranteed further limit what can be inferred from the demonstration.

citations.quote: First thing to configure is the trading pair.
